summary.zh: 选对研究方法、定样本量并提炼洞察
summary.en: Pick a research method, size the study, and synthesize insights.

description.zh: 按研究目标和产品阶段选择方法，给出样本量与饱和度的依据，再把编码后的观察聚类成洞察。单一来源的观点会被标记为轶事而不是结论。随附脚本只依赖 Python 标准库。
description.en: Matches the method to the research goal and product stage, justifies sample size and saturation, then clusters coded observations into insights. Single-source claims are flagged as anecdotes. Scripts use only the Python standard library.
